einzeiler: True horror stories about unsettling encounters, stalkers, and chilling experiences.
kurzfassung: This episode features a collection of terrifying true horror stories. Listeners hear about relentless stalkers, a deeply unsettling hotel experience in rural Tennessee, and a menacing encounter in the woods of Belize. The accounts explore the chilling reality of trusting one's instincts when faced with danger.
stichpunkte: A 16-year-old girl is relentlessly pursued and stalked by a 32-year-old man who tracks her down even years later at university.
Two travelers check into a remote hotel in rural Tennessee where a suspicious desk clerk, a man hiding in their room, and a sudden power outage force them to flee.
A child in Belize encounters a menacing man hiding on a rocky cliff with a machete near her mother's campsite.
A grocery store cashier in a small Southern Illinois town is targeted by an older delivery driver faking a leg injury.
A hiker on a wildlife trail is charged by a knife-wielding man who chases her out of the woods.
A woman reflects on years of being stalked by a mysterious man in black during her youth, later suspecting a connection to her brother's troubled former houseguest.
